name: Five
source: An autonomous android dubbed "Automata" - both guide and guardian to the "ONE'S GIFT" recipient. Five is so human-like you'd forget she's mechanical. She takes a special interest in the misfit Nagi among the academy's elite, watching over him as far as protocol allows.
